# This project has no third-party Python dependencies.
#
# The pipeline (deid.pipeline), the two-pass runner (deid.run_model), the
# scorer (deid.metrics), and the test suite all use only the Python standard
# library. Python 3.9 or newer is required.
#
# Running a real evaluation additionally needs a local llama.cpp server
# (`llama-server`) hosting one of the GGUF models listed in the README. That is
# a separate native binary, not a Python package, so it is not listed here.
